name: soundings
description: Complete research and creative inquiry with independent Search, Study, Explore, and Shape skills.

interface.shortDescription: Research, understand, explore, and shape the work
interface.longDescription: Soundings helps agents investigate external evidence, synthesize a body of material, develop concrete creative possibilities, and make consequential choices or corrections judgeable. Four independent skills can own complete commissions or contribute inside an existing task. An optional local Python helper preserves selected source snapshots for exact rereading and bounded evidence responses.
defaultPrompt: Investigate the evidence and conditions that could change this decision.
Reconcile these materials into a useful explanation of what we know.
Develop this idea into a complete candidate I can react to.
Make this consequential choice judgeable and carry the correction through.
